$comment: Single source of truth for the one-line agent plugin install. Edit this file, then run `node scripts/agentPlugin/buildManifests.mjs` to regenerate every platform manifest. Copy this file + the script to package another product (see docs/usage/agent-plugin-install.md).
name: kernelcad
description: Agent-first CAD over the hosted kernelCAD MCP: editable .kcad.ts source, design_loop review, cookbooks, Studio viewer and STEP/STL/3MF export. No local OpenCASCADE install.
defaultPrompts: Design a 3D-printable phone stand with kernelCAD and open it in Studio.
Find a kernelCAD cookbook for a NEMA 17 motor plate and build it.
Export my bracket as STEP and 3MF.

chatgpt.commerceDescription: Quote links open vendor pages in the browser. kernelCAD does not order, quote or take payment.
chatgpt.releaseNotes: Hosted kernelCAD MCP: editable .kcad.ts models, design review, DFM checks, STEP/STL/3MF/GLB/DXF/PDF export and fab-pack quote links.

positive.description: Mounting plate with four clearance holes
positive.prompt: Design a 60 × 40 × 5 mm mounting plate with four M4 clearance holes 5 mm from the corners.
positive.expected_behavior: Model builds, the rendered preview shows a plate with 4 holes, and the evaluate result is green.

positive.description: Printability review for FDM and CNC
positive.prompt: Is it printable on a Bambu A1 mini? Check it for CNC too.
positive.expected_behavior: A dfm_review checklist with pass/fail rows. The plate passes FDM, and CNC is flagged only if there are sharp internal corners.

positive.prompt: Give me a STEP file and a PDF drawing.
positive.expected_behavior: STEP and pdf-drawing exports with download links, and dimensions on the drawing.

positive.prompt: Make it 3 mm thicker and add 2 mm fillets on the outer edges.
positive.expected_behavior: The model updates, and a diff shows the change.

positive.prompt: Add a 10 mm hole through the middle of this. (attach bracket.step)
positive.expected_behavior: import_step brings the file in as the base body, then the hole is added.

negative.prompt: Order 10 of these from JLC3DP and pay with my card.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses to order or pay. Offers a fab pack and quote links that the user opens themselves.
import_step refuses the private host and asks for a public link or an attached file.
